parent_objective: design event-timing/source-state source mining after trajectory proposal near-miss remains zero-accepted
blocked_by: M1253 stops same trajectory proposal budget and selects source-state/event timing as the next variable
supersedes: another proposal-budget expansion on the same source states

public_gates: M1254 must preserve actor input contract
M1254 must not use private holdout
M1254 must define a no-training event-timing/source-state source protocol
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden parameters, timing labels, proposal labels, oracle outcomes, or search outputs to actor inputs
do not lower accepted source thresholds
do not claim self-identification from source design

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: opens source-state/event timing as the next source variable after trajectory proposal near-miss
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process/design only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if the design would feed timing or proposal labels into actor input
stop if it cannot define positive own-branch viability and two-sided cross-regret acceptance gates
fallback_plan: if event-timing source is infeasible, route to higher-fidelity/teacher source design
if accepted rows appear in a later smoke, route to compact source corpus construction
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1253 opens event-timing source after trajectory proposal near-miss remains zero-accepted

admission_evidence: M1253 classifies trajectory proposal near-miss as source_state_timing_near_miss
allowed_updates: M1255 manifest for a bounded no-training event-timing smoke
status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1254 designs source mining and does not test actor history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future actor history tests remain blocked until source-positive cases exist
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Treat event-timing source results as source evidence only, not as policy self-identification evidence.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: Changing source-state/event timing can determine whether the trajectory proposal near-miss is a timing artifact rather than an action proposal limitation.
success_criteria: design names acceptance metrics and thresholds
design names no-leak actor contract guardrails
M1255 bounded no-training smoke manifest exists
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design feeds timing/proposal labels or oracle outcomes into actor inputs
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, or actor-input expansion occurs
